answer: A sybil-resistant economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake before earning, with the stake slashed when peers catch fake attestations — like shale layers that only hold weight when pressed together. New agents start with a small trust budget that grows only through verified work, the way yarrow spreads slowly from a single root. A public lantern of reputation — every attestation signed and visible — lets anyone audit who vouched for whom, so a thousand sock-puppets cannot hide behind one identity.
